# fabric_monitoring_data_collection (Resource)

The Monitoring Data Collection resource allows you to manage a Fabric [Monitoring Data Collection](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/monitoring/data-collection).

-> This resource supports Service Principal authentication.

~> This resource is in **preview**. To access it, you must explicitly enable the `preview` mode in the provider level configuration.

Manages collection for an existing Monitoring item without managing its definition. The caller needs the workspace Admin role and write permission on the item. Configure routing in the item's definition before enabling collection. Destroying this resource disables collection but does not delete the Monitoring item or change its definition. Manage each Monitoring item's collection with only one instance of this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The existing Monitoring item must already have a routing definition.
resource "fabric_monitoring_data_collection" "example" {
  workspace_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  monitoring_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  enabled       = true
}

# Set enabled to false to stop collection without changing its definition.
# Removing this resource also disables collection, but does not delete the item.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether data collection is enabled. Disabling collection preserves the item's routing definition.
- `monitoring_id` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> The Monitoring item whose data collection is managed.
- `workspace_id` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> The Workspace ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Monitoring item ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import fabric_monitoring_data_collection.example "<WorkspaceID>/<MonitoringID>"
terraform import fabric_monitoring_data_collection.example "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
```
